person.name: Santosh Choubey
person.title: Founder and Chairman, AISECT Group
person.education: B.E. Electronics & Communication Engineering, MANIT (NIT), Bhopal

factCheck.discrepancy: None - confirmed facts match the website

timeline.title: Born in Khandwa
timeline.text: Mr. J.P. Chaubey and Mrs. Sharda Chaubey were blessed with a son on 22nd September, 1955 at Khandwa, Madhya Pradesh, India.
timeline.imageAlt: Mr. J.P. Chaubey and Mrs. Sharda Chaubey

timeline.title: Selected for B.E. at MANIT, Bhopal
timeline.text: Selected for Bachelor of Engineering (Electronics & Communication Engineering) at Maulana Azad National Institute of Technology, Bhopal, Madhya Pradesh.

timeline.title: Selected in Indian Engineering Services
timeline.text: Achieved the remarkable milestone of being selected in the Indian Engineering Services. Later also selected for Indian Civil Services but chose to walk a different path.

timeline.title: Founded AISECT
timeline.text: Founded AISECT (All India Society for Electronics and Computer Technology) with a bold mission to bridge the digital and knowledge divide between India's cities and its villages.
timeline.imageAlt: All India Society for Electronics and Computer Technology AISECT

timeline.title: First Book on Computers in Hindi & Meghnad Saha Award
timeline.text: Published first book on Computers in Hindi titled 'कंप्यूटर एक परिचय'. Won the Meghnad Saha Award for Science Writing.
timeline.imageAlt: A STEP TOWARDS THE PROMOTION OF COMPUTER SKILL

timeline.title: National Award for Science Communication
timeline.text: Received National Award for Science Communication.

timeline.title: Launched Electroniki Magazine
timeline.text: The first Indian magazine on electronics and computers in Hindi launched. It has been published continuously for over 35 years and has won many accolades.

timeline.title: Literacy Campaigns Begin
timeline.text: Played a pivotal role in promoting literacy through campaigns and art forms in undivided Madhya Pradesh.

timeline.title: Vanmali Srijan Peeth Established
timeline.text: Vanmali Srijan Peeth and Vanmali Srijan Kendras established as a grassroots level literary and cultural initiative. Over 114 VSKs now promote local arts and culture.

timeline.title: Indian Literacy Movement
timeline.text: Made leading contribution in Indian literacy movement through the Literacy Campaigns in undivided Madhya Pradesh. Used art forms for promotion of Science and Literacy in rural areas.

timeline.title: Honored as Core Group of Dept. of Science & Technology
timeline.hindiTitle: विज्ञान एवं प्रौद्योगिकी विभाग के कोर ग्रुप में सम्मान
timeline.text: The society established by Santosh, SECT was honored as the Core Group of Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India under his able leadership for 10 years.
timeline.imageAlt: Honored as the Core Group of Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India

timeline.title: Acknowledged by World Bank and IIM-A
timeline.hindiTitle: विश्व बैंक और IIM-A द्वारा मान्यता
timeline.text: AISECT evolved its own Multipurpose IT Centre model for the first time to cater rural and semi urban milieu, acknowledged and published in IIM-Ahmedabad and World Bank Report.
timeline.imageAlt: Acknowledged by the World Bank and IIMA

timeline.title: IT Yatras
timeline.text: I.T. Yatras conducted in Madhya Pradesh, Maharashtra and Chhattisgarh.

timeline.title: Indian Innovation Award from Dr. Kalam
timeline.hindiTitle: डॉ. कलाम से भारतीय नवप्रवर्तन पुरस्कार
timeline.text: AISECT became a leading IT Training and Services Network in India, receiving the Indian Innovation Award from the then President of India, Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam.
timeline.imageAlt: How AISECT Won the Indian Innovation Award from Dr. Kalam

timeline.title: NASSCOM I.T. Innovation Award & CVRU Bilaspur
timeline.text: AISECT gets the NASSCOM I.T. Innovation Award from Dr. A.P.J. Abdul Kalam. Dr. C.V. Raman University established in Bilaspur, C.G.

timeline.title: 5000+ IT Kiosks at Grassroots
timeline.text: AISECT participated as a leading Service Centre Agency in the Common Service Centre Project and established more than 5000 CSCs at Gram Panchayats.
timeline.imageAlt: AISECT Set Up Over 5000 IT Kiosks at the Grassroots Level

timeline.title: Rabindranath Tagore University Established
timeline.text: RNTU, established in 2010, is the 1st private university in central India in an underdeveloped district of Raisen. It imbibes cultural values of Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore.

timeline.title: Financial Inclusion Network
timeline.text: AISECT became a prominent Financial Inclusion Network in India, engaging in BF, BC, and UID activities with leading banks.

timeline.title: AISECT University, Hazaribagh
timeline.text: AISECT University was established in Hazaribagh district of Jharkhand as the region's first private University and the first Skills University of the State.

timeline.title: Dr. C.V. Raman University, Vaishali, Bihar
timeline.text: CVRU Bihar established as the first private university in the region of North Bihar, dedicated to achieving excellence in education and research.
timeline.imageAlt: Dr. C.V. Raman University, Vaishali, Bihar

timeline.title: Dr. C.V. Raman University, Khandwa & TICAC
timeline.text: C.V. Raman University established in Khandwa district, his birthplace. Tagore International Centre for Arts and Culture (TICAC) established at RNTU.
timeline.imageAlt: Dr. C.V. Raman University, Khandwa, M.P.

timeline.title: Vishwarang Foundation Launched
timeline.text: Vishwarang, Global Cultural Festival, was started in 2019 at Rabindranath Tagore University as a global platform celebrating Indian literature, culture, art, music and cinema.

timeline.title: Tagore National School of Drama
timeline.text: The Tagore National School of Drama established in July 2021, making it the first such drama academy run by a private university.
timeline.imageAlt: Tagore National School of Drama, Bhopal, M.P.

timeline.title: SCOPE Global Skills University & NCSDE
timeline.text: SCOPE Global Skills University established in Bhopal — Central India's First NEP and NSQF Aligned Skills University. National Centre for Skill Development and Entrepreneurship launched.
timeline.imageAlt: SCOPE Global Skills University, Bhopal, M.P

timeline.title: Vishwarang 1st International Edition in Mauritius
timeline.text: The 6th edition of VishwaRang was held in Mauritius in collaboration with the World Hindi Secretariat, with participation from over 300 delegates and representatives from 21 countries across five continents.

institutions.name: Rabindranath Tagore University
institutions.description: 1st private university in central India in an underdeveloped district of Raisen. Imbues cultural values of Gurudev Rabindranath Tagore. Focuses on Arts, Humanities and Liberal arts.

institutions.name: AISECT University
institutions.description: Region's first private University and the first Skills University of the State. A change maker in this LWE district.

institutions.name: Dr. C.V. Raman University, Bihar
institutions.description: First private university in the region of North Bihar. Known for Engineering and Skill education. Also has a Buddhist study Centre.

institutions.name: Dr. C.V. Raman University, M.P.
institutions.description: Established in his birthplace Khandwa. Focuses on Agriculture Education and Research, Social Work and Rural Development.

institutions.name: SCOPE Global Skill University
institutions.description: Central India's First NEP and NSQF Aligned Skills University. Has over ten centres of Excellence on Campus with leading Industries.

institutions.name: Dr. C.V. Raman University, C.G.
institutions.description: Set up in a scheduled tribal block. Named after Nobel laureate Sir C.V. Raman. Focuses on Science and Technology education, skill development, sports.

culturalInstitutions.name: Vanmali Srijan Peeth
culturalInstitutions.description: Grassroots level literary and cultural initiative. Over 114 VSKs promote local arts and culture and provide platform to local talents.

culturalInstitutions.name: Tagore National School of Drama
culturalInstitutions.description: First drama academy run by a private university, established in July 2021. Offers courses in acting, direction, scriptwriting, and stage management.

culturalInstitutions.name: Vishwarang Foundation
culturalInstitutions.description: Global literary and arts festival celebrating India's multilingual and multicultural heritage. 6th edition held in Mauritius in 2024 with participation from 21 countries.

I appreciate the AISECT's efforts in taking IT to people.

poem.title: आना जब मेरे अच्छे दिन हों
lines: आना जब मेरे अच्छे दिन हों.
जब दिल में निष्कपट ज्योति की तरह
जब मन के अछूते कोने में
चढ़ी न हो धूल की परत
आ जाए कोई अच्छी सी पुस्तक हाथ
या कि गर्मी में छत पर सोते हुए
